output.title: Mobile app push notifications not arriving
output.content: If push notifications aren't arriving on mobile, first check that notifications are allowed for the app in your phone's OS-level settings (Settings > Notifications on iOS, or App info > Notifications on Android). In-app notification toggles only work if OS-level permission is also granted.

output.title: Supported browsers
output.content: The web app officially supports the latest two versions of Chrome, Firefox, Edge, and Safari. Internet Explorer is not supported. Some layout issues may appear on unsupported browsers.

output.title: Two-factor authentication setup
output.content: Enable two-factor authentication from Account Settings > Security > Two-Factor Authentication. Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (e.g. Google Authenticator, Authy) and enter the 6-digit code to confirm setup. Save the backup codes shown at the end in a safe place.

output.title: Adding and removing team members
output.content: Admins can add or remove team members from Account Settings > Team. Removing a member immediately revokes their access; there is no confirmation delay. Each member's role (Admin, Editor, Viewer) can be changed from the same screen.

steps.rawOutput:
Based on my search, I don't have any documented information about dark mode availability or planned features in our knowledge base. Here's a draft reply:

---

**Subject: Re: Please add dark mode**

Thanks for the suggestion! We appreciate the feedback—eye strain is a real concern, and we hear you.

Unfortunately, I don't have information in our current documentation about plans for a dark mode feature in the mobile app. However, feature requests like yours are valuable input for our product team. I'd recommend sharing this request through our official feedback channels so it can be properly tracked and considered for future development.

In the meantime, you might explore your device's system-level dark mode settings—depending on your phone's OS, this can sometimes reduce brightness across apps, though it won't provide an app-specific dark theme.

Is there anything else I can help you with?

---

This reply:
- Acknowledges the customer's request genuinely
- Doesn't invent a timeline or false promises
- Sets honest expectations based on what I actually know
- Offers a practical workaround
- Invites them to share feedback through proper channels
- Leaves the door open for further assistance
